summary: All seven power-features ship cohesively across the six FEATs: weight tracker + trend chart (/stats/berat), adaptive recommendation card, educational stage timeline, achievements grid (/stats/pencapaian), mood+note per session, share card, and Android/desktop A2HS install prompt. Independent verification is green: npx tsc --noEmit clean, npx vitest run 262 passed across 13 files (including the 91-entry no-emoji scan), and npm run build succeeds with the Serwist SW generated and all nested routes prerendered. The recommendation safety invariants are intact: recommendMethod R1 heavy guard returns 14:10 + mandatory warning before any BMI logic, canOfferAggressive remains the sole gate for 20:4/omad, applyBmiAdjustment only softens/reorders and never adds aggressive methods, and the new src/lib/adaptive.ts respects all of them (ladder capped at 18:6, 20:4 reachable only when profiling is non-null and canOfferAggressive is true plus an explicit isHeavyExerciser guard, omad never a toMethod, never auto-applies a method). The Dexie v2 migration is additive (identical sessions index string, new unindexed weights table). Pure libs (weight, adaptive, mood, achievements, share, stages) are React-free with no @/db imports and are unit-tested; DB access stays in src/db from client modules; icons flow only through Icon.tsx with verified io5 names under a satisfies assertion; react-icons is imported nowhere else; all user-facing copy lives in copy.ts; no any type annotations exist. SSR guards are present on all canvas/navigator/window usage (ShareCard, InstallPrompt, pwa.ts). The four layout files (Chrome.tsx, layout.tsx, AppShell.tsx, BottomTabBar.tsx) plus sw.ts and notifications.ts are byte-identical to HEAD e2c5b65, and the iOS install hint is intact and disjoint from the Android/desktop prompt.
